description: Fetch a Gate-protected URL, automatically paying the x402 paywall from the agent wallet (prepaid balance preferred, escrow payment otherwise). Returns the page content plus what was paid. Refuses and explains if the price exceeds the per-payment or daily cap. Ungated URLs are fetched normally and cost nothing.

url.description: Absolute https:// URL to retrieve. If it answers HTTP 402 the paywall is paid automatically, so check the price with gate_get_price first when the cost matters.

name: gate_fetch
